presentationRules: #view-nodes .ns-panel { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 3px; min-height: 0; min-width: 0; box-shadow: none; }
#view-nodes h4 { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }
#view-nodes h4 small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 400; text-align: right; }

#view-nodes button, #view-nodes select, #view-nodes input, #view-nodes textarea { min-width: 0; padding: 0 7px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; color: var(--text); background: var(--control-bg); font-size: 11px; font-family: inherit; }

#view-nodes button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--ns-accent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ns-accent) 10%, var(--control-bg)); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ns-accent) 50%, var(--line)); }
#view-nodes button.danger { color: var(--red); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--red) 40%, var(--line)); }
#view-nodes .ns-empty { padding: 18px 12px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.7; text-align: center; }

#view-nodes .ns-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 18px; padding: 0 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; color: var(--muted); background: var(--panel-inset); font-size: 9px; white-space: nowrap; }
#view-nodes .ns-tag.nominal, #view-nodes .ns-tag.tracking, #view-nodes .ns-tag.locked { color: var(--green); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--green) 45%, var(--line)); }

#view-nodes .ns-tag.standby, #view-nodes .ns-tag.acquiring, #view-nodes .ns-tag.slewing, #view-nodes .ns-tag.warning { color: var(--orange); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--orange) 45%, var(--line)); }
#view-nodes .ns-tag.safe, #view-nodes .ns-tag.blocked { color: var(--red); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--red) 45%, var(--line)); }
#view-nodes .ns-formation { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 2; display: grid; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 16px 14px; font-size: 13px; }
#view-nodes .ns-formation-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
#view-nodes .ns-formation-head label { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
#view-nodes .ns-sliders { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px 22px; }
#view-nodes .ns-slider { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(96px, 150px) minmax(0, 1fr) 82px 30px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 36px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }

#view-nodes .ns-slider input[type="range"] { appearance: none; height: 7px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ns-accent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--ns-accent) 35%, var(--line))); cursor: pointer; }

#view-nodes .ns-slider input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb { appearance: none; width: 20px; height: 20px; border: 3px solid var(--surface); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ns-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--ns-accent), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.25); cursor: pointer; }
#view-nodes .ns-slider input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb { width: 18px; height: 18px; border: 3px solid var(--surface); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ns-accent); cursor: pointer; }
#view-nodes .ns-slider input[type="number"] { height: 30px; padding: 0 6px; text-align: right; font-family: "Consolas", monospace; font-size: 13px; }
#view-nodes .ns-formation-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; padding-top: 10px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
#view-nodes .ns-live { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap; }
#view-nodes .ns-deploy { height: 36px; padding: 0 18px; color: #fff; background: var(--green); border-color: var(--green); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; }
#view-nodes .ns-inspector { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / 3; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; }
#view-nodes .ns-fleet-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
#view-nodes .ns-fleet { flex: 0 0 auto; max-height: 172px; overflow: auto; scrollbar-width: thin; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-strong); }

#view-nodes .ns-fleet-row { width: 100%; height: 34px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 14px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 65%, transparent); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; text-align: left; }
#view-nodes .ns-fleet-row[aria-selected="true"] { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ns-accent) 12%, var(--surface)); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 var(--ns-accent); }
#view-nodes .ns-fleet-body b { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; }
#view-nodes .ns-fleet-body small { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--muted); font-size: 9px; }
#view-nodes .ns-detail { flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow: auto; scrollbar-width: thin; }
#view-nodes .ns-status-head h3 { margin: 4px 0 6px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
#view-nodes .ns-status-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
#view-nodes .ns-shape figure { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 96px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 8px; align-items: center; margin: 0; }
#view-nodes .ns-shape img { width: 96px; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; object-fit: cover; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; background: #06101b; }

#view-nodes .ns-values > div { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 0; border-bottom: 1px dotted color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 70%, transparent); }
#view-nodes .ns-values dd { margin: 0; font-size: 10px; text-align: right; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
#view-nodes .ns-power span { display: grid; gap: 2px; padding: 5px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; color: var(--muted); background: var(--panel-inset); font-size: 9px; }
#view-nodes .ns-power-bar, #view-nodes .ns-progress { display: block; height: 4px; margin-top: 6px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--line); }
#view-nodes .ns-power-bar b, #view-nodes .ns-progress b { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--green); }
#view-nodes .ns-eq-status span { display: grid; gap: 1px; padding: 4px 7px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--panel-inset); font-size: 9px; }
#view-nodes .ns-terminal { padding: 7px 8px; margin-bottom: 5px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-left: 3px solid var(--muted); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--panel-inset); }
#view-nodes .ns-terminal-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 10px; }
#view-nodes .ns-terminal-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 2px 8px; margin: 5px 0 3px; font-size: 9px; color: var(--muted); }
#view-nodes .ns-terminal small { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-size: 9px; }
#view-nodes .ns-editor-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 9px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-strong); }
#view-nodes .ns-editor-section { padding: 9px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); display: grid; gap: 6px; }
#view-nodes .ns-editor-section h3 { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; }
#view-nodes .ns-editor-section h3 small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 400; text-align: right; }
#view-nodes .ns-editor label { display: grid; gap: 3px; font-size: 10px; color: var(--muted); }
#view-nodes .ns-grid-3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 6px; }
#view-nodes .ns-grid-epoch { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 6px; align-items: end; }
#view-nodes .ns-model-preview { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 96px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 8px; align-items: center; margin: 0; }
#view-nodes .ns-model-preview img { width: 96px; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; object-fit: cover; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; background: #06101b; }

#view-nodes .ns-eq-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 18px minmax(0, 1fr) 96px 96px 24px; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 5px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--panel-inset); }
#view-nodes .ns-eq-name b { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
#view-nodes .ns-eq-name small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 8px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
#view-nodes .ns-eq-add { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 5px; }

#view-nodes .ns-errors { margin: 8px 12px 0; padding: 8px 10px 8px 24px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--red) 45%, var(--line)); border-radius: 3px; color: var(--red); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--red) 8%, var(--surface)); font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.6; }
#view-nodes .ns-editor-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 12px 14px; }

#view-nodes .ns-tip { position: fixed; z-index: 120; max-width: 300px; padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.55; pointer-events: none; }
